review_scope: Targeted review of ten headings, automated findings, parcel and order vocabulary, numeric examples, package dimensions, currencies, clothing-fit ambiguity and reproducible samples. Not a complete line edit of every passage. Follow-up review of parcel and quote polysemy.

corrections.translation: Kako napisati jasne upute za ručnu narudžbu na CNShopperu

corrections.source: Write down packed length, width, height and actual weight, with units. Keep destination and route constant when testing how a packing decision changes the estimate. Record any service included in only one quote.
corrections.translation: Zapišite duljinu, širinu, visinu i stvarnu masu zapakiranog paketa te navedite mjerne jedinice. Kada provjeravate utjecaj načina pakiranja na cijenu, zadržite isto odredište i istu dostavnu uslugu. Zabilježite usluge uključene samo u jednu ponudu.

corrections.source: Where should I look for CNShopper’s current order and return instructions?
corrections.translation: Gdje mogu pronaći aktualne upute CNShoppera za naručivanje i povrat robe?

corrections.source: For a real order, write down the rejected alternative as well as the chosen option if confusion is likely. A useful sentence is, “I want the complete green bag with shoulder strap. Do not select the spare shoulder strap offered under the same listing.” That instruction names the actual risk. A vague phrase such as “choose the correct version” leaves the purchaser with exactly the ambiguity you were trying to remove.
corrections.translation: Ako bi pri naručivanju moglo doći do zabune, zabilježite i odabranu i odbačenu varijantu. Na primjer: „Želim cijelu zelenu torbu s remenom za rame. Nemojte odabrati rezervni remen koji se nudi u istom oglasu.” Takva uputa objašnjava točnu razliku. Općenita napomena poput „odaberite ispravnu verziju” ne pomaže osobi koja naručuje.

corrections.source: Imagine seller A supplies two folders at 30 each and charges 8 to send both to the warehouse. The seller-order subtotal is 60 and the combined domestic cost is 68. Recording each folder as 30 plus 8 gives a total of 76 and overstates what was spent. You can allocate 4 of domestic cost to each folder for your internal analysis, but the seller charged 8 once. Keep the original invoice total alongside any optional allocation.
corrections.translation: Pretpostavimo da prodavatelj A prodaje dvije mape za dokumente po cijeni od 30 za svaku i naplaćuje 8 za njihovu zajedničku dostavu do skladišta. Roba košta 60, a s domaćom dostavom ukupno 68. Dodate li 8 svakoj mapi, dobit ćete previsok iznos od 76. U vlastitoj evidenciji možete svakoj mapi pripisati 4 za dostavu, ali prodavatelj je naplatio 8 samo jednom. Zadržite izvorni iznos računa uz vlastitu raspodjelu.

corrections.source: Now suppose seller B supplies one binder at 50 plus 6 domestic delivery. The second purchase costs 56. Your combined purchase-stage cost for the three pieces is 124 in this illustrative example: 68 from seller A and 56 from seller B. Nothing about that sum identifies the price of the eventual international parcel. It is simply the cost of obtaining these items at the warehouse under the stated assumptions.
corrections.translation: Pretpostavimo sada da prodavatelj B prodaje jedan registrator za 50 i naplaćuje 6 za domaću dostavu. Druga kupnja košta 56. U ovom primjeru tri artikla do dolaska u skladište ukupno koštaju 124: kod prodavatelja A platili ste 68, a kod prodavatelja B 56. Iz tog iznosa još ne možete odrediti cijenu međunarodne pošiljke.

corrections.source: For an illustrative example, your own jacket measures 54 centimetres flat underarm to underarm. A seller chart lists chest 108. The figures might describe similar garment widths if 108 is the complete garment circumference using comparable endpoints. They are not necessarily equivalent if 108 is a recommended wearer measurement. This arithmetic only identifies the question to ask. It does not prove that the substitute will fit, because cut, sleeve shape and fabric behaviour can also differ.
corrections.translation: Primjerice, vaša jakna položena na ravnu površinu široka je 54 cm od pazuha do pazuha. U prodavateljevoj tablici uz mjeru za prsa stoji 108. Mjere se mogu podudarati ako je 108 puni opseg jakne na istoj visini. Ako je to preporučeni opseg prsa osobe koja nosi jaknu, vrijednosti nisu nužno usporedive. Račun vam pokazuje što trebate pitati. Na pristajanje također utječu kroj, oblik rukava i svojstva tkanine.

corrections.source: If you already received the item overseas, describe the delivery and opening dates as accurately as possible. Read the service information attached to the parcel and ask where to submit the relevant documents. Do not send an unrequested international return to an address copied from a domestic label. Ask for the authorized recipient, required reference, method and who would pay each leg before arranging any shipment. Keep written instructions together with the case so future tracking can be matched to the correct request.
corrections.translation: Ako ste već primili predmet u inozemstvu, navedite što točnije kada je paket dostavljen i kada ste ga otvorili. Pročitajte podatke o usluzi i pitajte kamo poslati dokumentaciju. Nemojte na svoju ruku slati povrat u inozemstvo na adresu s naljepnice za domaću dostavu. Prvo zatražite potvrdu primatelja, potrebnu oznaku povrata, način slanja i informaciju o tome tko plaća pojedine dionice. Sačuvajte pisane upute uz predmet kako biste novom broju za praćenje pridružili ispravan zahtjev.

corrections.source: For example, your worksheet might contain an international allowance of 70 and later show an accepted quote of 82 in the same currency. Your freight budget moved by 12. You did not spend 152 merely because both figures appear in the file. If a separate optional service was purchased, give it its own field and determine whether the quote already includes it before adding it again.
corrections.translation: Primjerice, u tablici predvidite 70 za međunarodnu dostavu, a poslije prihvatite ponudu od 82 u istoj valuti. Dostava tako košta 12 više od planiranog. To što su obje brojke u tablici ne znači da ste potrošili 152. Zasebno kupljenu dodatnu uslugu zapišite u posebno polje i prije zbrajanja provjerite je li već uključena u ponudu.

corrections.source: Create a parcel description that can be repeated
corrections.translation: Kako opisati paket za ponovljivu usporedbu

corrections.source: Imagine one book, two folded shirts and a rigid pencil case. If the initial quote uses a carton measuring 35 by 25 by 15 centimetres at 1,800 grams, copy those values into the second comparison in the units requested. Do not enter the book dimensions for the second search by mistake. Preserve the figures as illustrative until they represent a real measured parcel. A consistent assumption makes a meaningful comparison even before the final quote is available.
corrections.translation: Zamislite jednu knjigu, dvije presavijene majice i kruti etui za olovke. Ako se u početnom predračunu koristi kartonska kutija dimenzija 35 x 25 x 15 centimetara i težine 1800 grama, kopirajte te vrijednosti u drugu usporedbu u traženim jedinicama. Nemojte pogrešno unijeti dimenzije knjige za drugo pretraživanje. Ove su brojke primjer dok ne dobijete stvarne mjere paketa. Dosljedna pretpostavka čini smislenu usporedbu čak i prije nego što je konačna ponuda dostupna.

corrections.source: For a numerical illustration, suppose one quote shows 85 units of your comparison currency for freight plus 5 for required packing, while the second shows 92 including the same packing. The comparable amounts are 90 and 92. Comparing 85 and 92 exaggerates the difference. If the second quote does not state whether packing is included, leave that total unresolved until you can verify it. These numbers explain the arithmetic and do not represent a CNShopper rate.
corrections.translation: Za numeričku ilustraciju, recimo da jedna ponuda navodi 85 jedinica vaše usporedbene valute za prijevoz plus 5 za potrebno pakiranje, dok druga navodi 92 uključujući isto pakiranje. Usporedivi iznosi su 90 i 92. Usporedbom 85 i 92 pretjeruje se u razlici. Ako druga ponuda ne navodi je li pakiranje uključeno, ostavite taj ukupni iznos neriješen dok ga ne možete provjeriti. Ovi brojevi objašnjavaju aritmetiku i ne predstavljaju tarifu CNShoppera.

corrections.source: Separate a destination comparison from a split-parcel decision
corrections.translation: Odvojite usporedbu odredišta od odluke o podjeli pošiljke

corrections.source: Save the pair of quotes, date, parcel description and choice in a private record. Name the factor that determined the outcome. For instance, “same packed carton, different destinations; chose address B because the eligible service fit the recipient's schedule and total budget.” If the choice depended on an estimated weight, mark it for review after the actual packing data arrives.
corrections.translation: Spremite par ponuda, datum, opis paketa i izbor u privatnom zapisu. Navedite čimbenik koji je odredio ishod. Na primjer, „ista zapakirana kutija, različita odredišta; odabrana adresa B jer kvalificirana usluga odgovara rasporedu i ukupnom proračunu primatelja.“ Ako je izbor ovisio o procijenjenoj težini, označite ga za pregled nakon što stignu stvarni podaci o pakiranju.

corrections.source: Compare the full alternatives. One quote for the current pieces does not represent the cost of shipping the later pieces separately. A future combined quote may also change when all dimensions are known. Record the chosen scenario as “dispatch confirmed item now; remaining items held for intake” or “wait for all matched pieces.” That wording prevents a later reader from assuming every item on the original purchase was inside the first outbound parcel.
corrections.translation: Usporedite potpune alternative. Jedna ponuda za trenutne komade ne predstavlja trošak otpreme kasnijih komada zasebno. Buduća zajednička ponuda također se može promijeniti kad budu poznate sve dimenzije. Zabilježite odabrani scenarij kao „pošalji potvrđenu stavku sada; preostale stavke zadržane za prijem“ ili „čekaj sve usklađene komade.“ Taj tekst sprječava kasnijeg čitatelja da pretpostavi da je svaka stavka na izvornoj kupnji bila unutar prvog paketa koji se šalje iz skladišta kupcu.

corrections.source: Preserve the assumptions with the quote you choose. When the actual parcel is packed, update its weight and dimensions and check the service still offered for the complete address. This last check is particularly important if the two addresses had different delivery arrangements. A parcel that looked cheaper to send to a relative may become less attractive if its size prevents collection from the intended location.
corrections.translation: Uz odabranu ponudu za dostavu sačuvajte pretpostavke izračuna. Kad je paket zapakiran, ažurirajte masu i dimenzije te provjerite je li usluga još dostupna za punu adresu. Ta je provjera posebno važna ako se uvjeti dostave na dvjema adresama razlikuju. Slanje rođaku možda je u početku izgledalo povoljnije, ali dimenzije mogu onemogućiti preuzimanje na predviđenom mjestu.

corrections.source: Imagine a jacket unavailable in short medium. The alternatives are regular medium and short large. Regular medium may keep a similar chest width while adding body length. Short large may retain the intended length while increasing width and shoulder span. Neither is universally “closer.” State which dimensions you need to preserve and compare both alternatives with those requirements. If the necessary measurements are absent, the correct conclusion is uncertainty rather than a confident size recommendation.
corrections.translation: Pretpostavimo da jakna u veličini M kratke duljine nije dostupna. Izbor je između veličine M standardne duljine i veličine L kratke duljine. Standardna M može imati sličnu širinu preko prsa, ali dulje tijelo jakne. Kratka L može zadržati željenu duljinu, ali biti šira preko prsa i ramena. Nijedna opcija nije uvijek bliža. Navedite koje mjere želite zadržati i prema njima usporedite obje mogućnosti. Bez potrebnih mjera ne može se pouzdano preporučiti veličina.
